policies.name: AM-GetLicenseStatus
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<AssignMessage async="false" continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="AM-GetLicenseStatus">
    <DisplayName>AM-GetLicenseStatus</DisplayName>
    <AssignVariable>
        <Name>CompletePathURL</Name>
        <Template>/MCIMediaApi/api/Values/GetLicenseStatus</Template>
    </AssignVariable>
    <IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>false</IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>
</AssignMessage>

policies.name: AM-Set-PathSuffix-url
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<AssignMessage async="false" continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="AM-Set-PathSuffix-url">
    <DisplayName>AM-Set-PathSuffix-url</DisplayName>
    <AssignVariable>
        <Name>target.copy.pathsuffix</Name>

policies.name: AM-Set-Backend-Authorization
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<AssignMessage async="false" continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="AM-Set-Backend-Authorization">
    <DisplayName>AM-Set-Backend-Authorization</DisplayName>
    <Set>
        <Headers>
            <Header name="Authorization">Bearer {backend.access_token}</Header>
        </Headers>
    </Set>
    <IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>true</IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>
</AssignMessage>

policies.name: AM-Remove-Client-Authorization
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<AssignMessage async="false" continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="AM-Remove-Client-Authorization">
    <DisplayName>AM-Remove-Client-Authorization</DisplayName>
    <Remove>
        <Headers>
        <Header name="Authorization"/>
        </Headers>
    </Remove>
</AssignMessage>

policies.name: RF-GetLicenseDetail-Missing-ID
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<RaiseFault name="RF-GetLicenseDetail-Missing-ID">
  <DisplayName>RF GetLicenseDetail Missing ID</DisplayName>
  <FaultResponse>
    <Set>
      <Headers>
        <Header name="Content-Type">application/json</Header>
      </Headers>
      <StatusCode>400</StatusCode>
      <ReasonPhrase>Bad Request</ReasonPhrase>
      <Payload contentType="application/json"><![CDATA[
{
  "error": "invalid_request",
  "message": "License ID is required at the end of the path.",
  "expectedPath": "/api/Values/GetLicenseDetail/{licenseId}"
}
      ]]></Payload>
    </Set>
  </FaultResponse>
  <IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>true</IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>
</RaiseFault>
